description: room-cli --version exits 1 with a stderr line that must never be echoed. The line passes the stderr sanitizer's general grammar (Error: HTTP <code>: <letters and spaces>), so only the version read's own rule withholds it. Every other read is normal.
synthetic_assumptions: A failing --version is unobserved; the stderr line is a synthetic marker standing for private text.

responses.stderr: Error: HTTP 500: Synthetic private version marker
